items.reason: Written acceptance fixes reference iPhone 11/iOS 26 and MacBook Air M1/8 GB/macOS 26, Release workload and at least 1,000 operations over five runs, p95<=50 ms and no UI stall>=100 ms; it separately specifies 100 two-client batches, actual cross-process SSE, p95<=2 s, the <=60 s dropped-hint deadline and <=30 s poll-start bound. Recovery uses the synthetic reference workload, observable state/receipt/queue comparisons, stopped access and fail-closed reconciliation, with timed RPO<=24 h/RTO<=4 h and explicit lost-commit accounting. Missing hardware, failed recovery or exceeded targets blocks expansion. These are falsifiable planned conditions, not measurements.
